description: Combobox — searchable single- or multi-select (Popover + filtered listbox). A select-with-search built on the HDS Popover. The trigger shows the current selection (with `multiple`, a count and a removable chip per value); opening reveals a search field that filters the option list. `multiple creatable` is a chip input (a tag field): chips sit inline before the text input, suggestions open as you type, and Enter adds the typed text via `onCreate`. <Combobox multiple creatable options={skills} value={picked} onChange={setPicked} onCreate={(t) => setPicked((p) => [...p, t])} /> Full keyboard support (↑/↓ to move, Enter to choose, Esc/outside-click to close) and listbox/option ARIA. Controlled via `value` + `onChange`. <Combobox options={[{ value: 'us', label: 'United States' }, …]} value={country} onChange={setCountry} placeholder="Select a country" />

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((value: string) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void)

usage.when: Pick one value, or several with `multiple`, from a long list of options, with a search field that filters as you type.
usage.whenNot: A short list that needs no search, or an action list.
